latency.nestedMetricsLimit: unchangedPermit and role-await intervals are subsets of witness phases; physical-await contains actor queue/native/return. Durations are wall-clock envelopes and must not be double-counted or labeled pure CPU/AX time.
deduplicationReview: Within the first five jobs, whole witnesses are the largest measured serial component. Their opening/closing directory work and retained physical observations have separate purposes.

StageEngineSession.prepareCoordinatedDispatch already shares the fresh preflight with dispatch, and its independent post-READBACK witness already serves the coordinator's first confirmation. Removing either again would remove a currently required check, not duplicate work.

The final verifySelection intentionally takes three more complete samples, followed by worker health. In the fifth job they total175.646ms; its final sample is58.481ms. Reducing three to two would change the final confirmation contract and needs an explicit safety decision/tests; this trace alone does not establish a redundant read safe to remove.

The new observation instrumentation does not show a seconds-long actor queue in this run. Across255 successful observations actorQueue max0.428ms, nativeRead max16.485ms and actorToMainActor max3.633ms. Access/owner guards remain explicit wall-clock segments.

The old670ms pre-task gap does not recur. Revision2 contributes the maximum110.287ms pre-task envelope,110.237ms in sessionAvailabilityMS. This does not retroactively identify any earlier run's uninstrumented delay.
